full_prompt_en: A square digital science-fiction illustration centers an intricate mechanical alien form against a flat, very dark navy background. Its broad upper body is almost symmetrical, like a compact armored crest, with layered cobalt and cyan metal plates arranged around a round glowing amber lens at the top center. Short angular fins project to either side, while pointed ocher spikes rise along the outer shoulders and direct the eye back toward the bright middle. Small circular orange lights sit within blue housings on the left and right, repeating the warm center at a reduced scale. Beneath the upper plating, a textured purple cluster resembles folded organic material enclosed by the machine shell. Several thick gold tubes curve down from this central mass, bending outward and then inward like articulated tentacles before tapering near the lower edge. A smaller blue and gold face-like assembly hangs at the bottom center and completes the vertical axis. The figure floats without a visible floor or horizon; the empty dark ground makes every colored contour easy to trace. Thin grooves, seams, bolts, and beveled highlights subdivide the large metal shapes without hiding their overall silhouette. Even frontal illumination clarifies the blue plates, while the amber core and smaller lights provide warmer internal glow. Deep indigo shadow stays in the recesses between tubes and beneath the upper shell, giving the crowded mechanics depth. The palette shifts from cool turquoise and royal blue to burnished gold, orange, and violet, with little color outside the central object. The overall composition feels like a detailed game-art insignia, balanced, ornate, and electrically alive.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形数字科幻插画把复杂的机械异星形体置于平坦而极深的海军蓝背景上。宽阔上半部几乎对称，像紧凑的装甲徽章，层叠的钴蓝与青蓝金属板围绕顶部中央一枚发亮的圆形琥珀镜片排列。短小折角鳍片向两侧伸出，赭金色尖刺沿外侧肩部升起，把视线导回明亮中心。左右蓝色外壳内各有小小的橙色圆灯，以缩小尺度重复中央暖光。上部装甲下面，一团有肌理的紫色结构如同被机器外壳包住的褶皱有机质。数根粗金管从中央团块向下弯曲，先向外再向内，像有关节的触须，末端在下缘附近收尖。较小的蓝金色类面部组件悬在最下方中央，完成竖向中轴。形体悬浮着，没有可见地面或地平线；空旷深色底使每一道彩色轮廓易于追踪。细槽、接缝、螺栓和倒角亮边分割大金属形状，却没有遮住整体剪影。均匀的正面光照清蓝色板面，琥珀核心与小灯提供更暖的内部光。深靛蓝阴影留在管件之间和上壳下方的凹处，让拥挤机械显出纵深。配色从冷青绿与宝蓝转向磨亮的金、橙和紫罗兰，中央形体外几乎没有别的颜色。整体构图如细密的游戏美术徽记，平衡、繁复且仿佛带电。
style_prompt_en: The image has crisp, ornate digital game-art rendering, with nearly symmetrical masses built from interlocking plates, rounded housings, and curling tubular lines. Saturated cobalt, cyan, and indigo establish a cool base; amber and burnished gold lights punctuate it at regular intervals, while limited violet marks add a different material note. Hard beveled edges and thin engraved seams keep the mechanical layering readable even at high detail density. Bright frontal clarity mixes with small internal glows, leaving narrow dark recesses between overlapping parts. A plain deep-colored ground isolates the central silhouette and makes the radial and vertical rhythm unusually clear. The finish is glossy, dense, and emblematic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有清晰繁复的数字游戏美术渲染，以互锁片面、圆形外壳与卷曲管线搭成近乎对称的体量。饱和钴蓝、青蓝和靛蓝确立冷色基底，琥珀与磨亮金色的光点有节奏地穿插其中，少量紫罗兰色标出另一种材料。坚硬的倒角边缘与细刻接缝让高密度细节中的机械层次仍可辨。明亮的正面清晰度与小范围内部发光混合，重叠构件间留下狭窄暗缝。纯净深色底将中央剪影隔离，使放射和竖向节奏格外清楚。完成面光亮、密集且有徽章感。
theme_en: A brightly colored mechanical alien emblem with curling gold appendages
theme_zh: 带卷曲金色附肢的鲜艳机械异星徽章
name: StarCraft
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
